content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments allows digital creators to bypass traditional payment platforms that impose high fees and restrictions. This approach not only reduces transaction costs but also empowers creators to fully own their infrastructure and data. For example, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, using NOWPayments incurs only a 0.5% fee. This difference in fees can significantly add up—retaining $921 on 100 sales of a $97 product demonstrates the financial benefits of adopting a crypto payment solution.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling design assets with crypto payments comprises several key components that work seamlessly together. By using tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing, you create a stack that is both efficient and cost-effective. This architecture automates payment verification and product delivery, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for customers while minimizing the need for manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in countries facing financial isolation or where traditional payment platforms are heavily restricted. Whether you create ebooks, courses, templates, or design assets, you can harness the power of a sovereign digital commerce stack. The architecture allows you to sell without being beholden to third-party platforms, giving you autonomy over your business and the ability to reach a global audience.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include an effective hosting solution, a backend for logic processing, a database for order management, and a reliable payment gateway. Each component plays a critical role: hosting is handled by GitHub or Cloudflare Pages, order storage can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, and product delivery is facilitated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The integration of NOWPayments enables automatic payment verification in over 300 cryptocurrencies, streamlining the purchasing process for your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your design assets with crypto payments, first choose your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for secure crypto processing and connect your order storage solution. Load your products, configure payment settings, and ensure automated delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, regularly check and optimize your setup for a smoother customer experience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
